relations.rationale: Cleo and Yara being on different teams is consistent with there being multiple teams, mildly supporting the existence of at least two or more teams like three.
Vik's age relative to Dara has no bearing on which teams Dara and Yara are on.
Vik setting up watering cans in the morning is unrelated to volunteers sharing coffee and pastries.
Taking a short break around ten supports the idea that during that break they shared coffee and pastries.
A break around ten is a distinct event from midmorning activity buzzing with rakes and laughter, and doesn't directly support or contradict it.
The break around ten could be the same pause described as the group admiring progress as the sun rose higher, so it supports that claim.
Dara and Yara being on different teams supports the existence of multiple teams, consistent with there being three teams.
The midmorning buzz of activity and progress described in claim 24 supports the later claim that the group paused to admire the progress made.
